name: MyMusik
description: Play, pause, and skip music in your running MyMusik app. Browse albums and, with editing access, organize tracks into folders and update tags.

tools.name: mymusik_playback
tools.description: Control the current MyMusik queue. Resume or pause playback, skip to the next track, or go back one track. Requires playback access. To play a particular song, album or playlist by name, use the app's search and API tools.
